intro: Lesson 96: Revision: coordination: nerves, the eye and plant responses. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Explain how the eye changes to focus on a book after looking out of a window. Portal response box.
questions.a: Light from near object diverges more (1); ciliary muscles contract (1); suspensory ligaments slacken (1); lens becomes fatter/more rounded (1); refracts light more (1); image focused on retina (1).
questions.model: Teacher writes the first two points: 'The book is near, so the lens must refract light more. The ciliary muscles contract...'

questions.q: Describe how to investigate the effect of light from one side on seedlings.
questions.a: Grow seedlings in two boxes, one with a slit on one side (1); same type, number, water, temperature (1); after several days observe direction of growth (1).

questions.q: Explain why reflexes are important for survival.
questions.a: They are fast and automatic (1), protecting the body from harm before conscious thought (1).

questions.q: Describe the pathway of a reflex arc when touching a hot object.
questions.a: Receptor in skin detects heat (1); impulse along sensory neurone (1); relay neurone in spinal cord, synapses (1); motor neurone to muscle (effector) which contracts (1).
questions.model: Follow the cycle: receptor, sensory neurone, relay neurone, motor neurone, effector. One mark per correct linked step.

questions.q: How is the impulse passed across a synapse?
questions.a: Neurotransmitter is released (1) and diffuses across the gap to the next neurone (1).
Nervous: electrical, fast, short-lived (1); hormonal: chemical in blood, slower, longer-lasting (1).

questions.q: Big question: how does your hand move before you feel pain?
questions.a: A reflex arc through the spinal cord sends an impulse to the muscle before the brain processes the pain.
